//: Overhaul Prompt 8: Grand Stenchmaster pressure and eruptions (docs/gameplay-overhaul/12-pressure-and-eruptions.md). Subjects are characters who build pressure and release it into the ship's air, its openings and its structure. Opt-in: a subject does nothing until a script enables it (pressureSubject), and no chapter does. Brogath's pressure IS his Phase 14 Stability (data/story/stability/brogath.json): the same story variable, read and written through systems/stability.js, so there is only ever one number for him. Garrick's is new and lives in the ship's saved state. Stage ids are fixed (stable, uneasy, building, dangerous, critical, imminent); each subject sets where its own begin ('at'), and imminent is its maximum.
//levels: A release's size, from its intensity: the pressure (above 0) plus what was held in, times the subject's heldWeight; a controlled release counts controlScale as much.
//profiles: What a release does. gas: a finite source in the subject's room (amount and rate scale with the difficulty's releaseScale; the substance is the subject's). openings: the room's openings to other rooms, in data order: 'force' closed ones blown open, 'damage' of them left damaged, 'breakSeals' tears every seal in the room. damage: sections struck ('room' is the first of the room's impact list, 'room2' the second; a section id names one), never below damage.floor of the section. Leaks and fires only when a profile says so ('breach' on a damage entry, 'ignite').
//impact: The sections a release in each room strikes, in order (validated against data/ship/integrity.json: each must be one of the section's rooms). The washroom and the two zones belong to no section: a release there strikes nothing structural.

brogath.//: Embarrassment. His rises are his Stability triggers (flutter, laughed_at, apologized...), his calms its calms, and reassuring him is its 'general' prompt: the right thing to say calms him, the wrong thing sets him off. Holding it in works now and costs later: what he held counts in full at the eruption, and every hold makes the next embarrassment hit harder. Mellow and recovering (Phases 15-16) still soften his rises, as they always have. While a Stability incident runs or he is ANGRY, a scene owns him and this system waits.
brogath.name: Brogath

restrain.label: Ask Brogath to hold it in

release.label: Help Brogath let it out gently

garrick.//: Gas and ceremony. Food and drink charge him (a digesting modifier keeps him rising for a while); a Grand Stenchmaster ceremony is deliberate and fast, and he won't be settled in the middle of one. He has more control: his controlled release is half as big, and he can hold it in without it counting double, but what he holds seeps back out (bleed) a little every second. Nothing here reads or writes his story values (garrick_release and the rest stay the story's).
garrick.name: Garrick

restrain.label: Ask Garrick to hold it in

release.label: Let Garrick let it out, carefully
